@materialwebunofficial/md3e-web (Apache-2.0), https://materialwebunofficial.github.io

themes/md3e-tokens.css: generated by tools/build-md3e.mjs from md3e-web 1.0.4 (its dist/tokens.css, and color schemes from its src/theme/hct-color-engine.js, a port of Material Color Utilities).
roboto-variable.woff2, Roboto-OFL.txt: copied from md3e-web 1.0.4 (dist/fonts/).
components.js: built by tools/build-vendor.mjs from md3e-web 1.0.14: src/components/md-loading-indicator.js, src/components/md-progress-indicator.js and src/components/md-menu.js with the 43 modules they import (theme, motion, utils and token modules; tokens/loading-morphs.js and tokens/progress-morphs.js are AOSP, Apache-2.0). Each module runs in its own function scope, with its imports and exports rewritten to match; the sources are otherwise unchanged.
LICENSE, NOTICE: copied from md3e-web 1.0.14.

Why 1.0.14 for the components: its theme context reacts only to theme changes on ancestor elements. In 1.0.4 every style write on an ancestor (md-menu's own opening animation writes transform and opacity on each frame) re-synced every component, which held menus near 30 fps.

Three comments in motion/spring-physics.js were translated to English in components.js; the code is unchanged.
